mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN dm.theory_num < m.alert_value THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS is_alert, dm.theory_num, m.alert_value, m.name, m.type_name, m.type_id, m.id, m.alert_id FROM beam_material m LEFT JOIN beam_data_material dm ON m.id = dm.id WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.alert_value IS NOT NULL AND m.alert_value != '') AS subquery WHERE subquery.is_alert = '1' ORDER BY subquery.id ASC
